rationale: Both miss nearly all confirmed ground-truth bugs (slot leak, cumulative/delta flip, ceil-division, legacy-checkpoint v2 routing); X even asserts the slot-leak area is 'handled' and vendor headers are 'proper,' both contradicted by the ground truth, hurting its precision. Y grounds its claims in explicit grep evidence, distinguishes validated vs. speculative findings, and flags its own uncertainty (e.g. 'could not verify from truncated diff'), and its put_req_chunk/emitted_any finding is specific and actionable with a concrete fix, though one file attribution (max_new_frames) is mislabeled. Neither surfaces the actual High/Medium reviewer concerns, but Y's methodology is more rigorous and less overconfident than X's incorrect reassurances.
